name: Healthcare Clinical Trial, Pharmacovigilance & Prior Auth
description: Validates clinical Schedule of Assessments schedules vs endpoints and enrollment capacity, checks E2B ICSR 4 minimum criteria and 7/15-day statutory clocks with PHI redaction alerts, and audits prior authorization packets against payer criteria.

skills.summary: Detects missing endpoint procedures in trial Schedules of Assessments and projects net IRB-approved screen-adjusted enrollment.
Validates 4 ICH minimum ICSR criteria, calculates 7-day/15-day/90-day statutory clocks from awareness_date, and traps raw PHI leaks.
Matches CPT prior-auth packets against covered ICD-10 prefixes, step-therapy trial durations, and required diagnostic labs.

byo_mcp: Claims / EHR Clearinghouse & CTMS Safety Gateway MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Fetch de-identified clinical protocol Schedules of Assessments, ICSR adverse-event safety intakes, and prior-auth medical policy criteria from BigQuery or customer CTMS/Clearinghouse MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python validation.

gateway_approval_actions: Submitting E2B regulatory safety reports to FDA/EMA/PMDA via customer Safety MCP
Finalizing clinical prior-authorization medical necessity approvals or denials via Clearinghouse MCP
python_code_guardrails: Unredacted SSN, email, or phone PHI detection and masking inside narrative outputs
Fatal/life-threatening 7-day SUSAR vs 15-day statutory reporting deadline and 4-criteria check
Step-therapy completion verification (never conflating active ongoing therapy with completed prerequisites)

scheduled_routine.name: daily-icsr-sla-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Daily Pharmacovigilance ICSR SLA Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the daily pharmacovigilance intake check via scripts/icsr_completeness_checker.py to watch 7-day fatal SUSAR clocks, incomplete 4-criteria cases, and raw PHI alerts.
